description: Generate hard-SF-inflected, technically dense, multi-format documents that blend cutting-edge science with literary experimentation — DFW footnotes meet Gene Wolfe unreliability meet transformer mathematics meet SMILES notation meet Gadamer's hermeneutics. Draws technical vocabulary from ML, physics/chemistry, mathematics, biology, philosophy, and neuroscience simultaneously; uses real notation systems (equations, SMILES, code, logic); shifts between literary modes (footnotes, stream of consciousness, unreliable narration, overheard technical dialogue) within one document. Density is calibratable (low/medium/high/maximum; default high). Ground the technical content in real research — verify equations and molecules, don't fake precision. Use when technical rigor and literary play should coexist, or when the human asks for density and specificity. Triggers on: 'octane mode', 'maximum density', 'let the tensors gossip', 'technical delirium', 'DFW footnotes on [topic]'.
